jobs.theme: Elven realm of light: pale celadon/ivory mist and soft sunlit foliage in the quiet center. At cropped corners, graceful pale stone elven terraces with curved slim antique-gold inlay, overlapping light-green and muted forest-green leaves, a few small white flowers and thin branching roots. Forest canopy and leafy platforms viewed from above. Airy and refined, restrained mossy/leaf-green and ivory palette. Distinct from Vanaheim: elegant cultivated elven woodland, not dense wild roots.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone full-screen stage backdrop for a 2D Japanese anime fantasy tower defense game. Input image is STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE ONLY: existing Asgard backdrop. Create a NEW world-specific image, do not include Asgard's literal sun ornaments or pools unless the requested world needs them. Wide landscape 16:9, desired 1920x1080. Match the reference's clean hand-painted Japanese anime background illustration, restrained contour lines, softly separated color shapes, simple readable forms and decorative corner architecture. Camera STRICT OVERHEAD / TOP-DOWN, looking straight down, NO horizon, no side-view landscape. Detail is confined primarily to outer edges and cropped corner structures. Keep the central ~65% width by ~65% height quiet, open and low-contrast as a continuous environmental backdrop for a board rendered separately on top. No board, grid, tiles, characters, enemies, weapons, UI, lettering, runic text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, panel borders. Full bleed, opaque background. Center can have subtle atmospheric texture and depth but no central landmark or bright focal hotspot. Same scale, rendering complexity and decorative density as reference, not realistic, no 3D, no noisy micro-detail or crosshatching.

Top-down lush wilderness. Deep emerald, sage and warm bark-brown, organic rather than elven architecture. Simplify bark and leaves to large anime-painted shapes, no tiny repetitive texture.
